## Description

Solves non-linear fluid dynamics equations (e.g. Burgers' equation) via neural networks as an analogy for option implied volatility propagation and shockwave formation.

## Where it may fit

Extreme option volatility spikes, earnings releases, market regime transitions.

## Vehicles

Options Market Makers, Volatility Arbitrage Desks.

## Required data

Option surface chain quotes, spot index levels, strike and expiry matrices.

## Caveats

Requires tuning loss function balance between non-linear PDE residuals and empirical market quotes.
